title: Cyber Resilience For Dummies
subject: Cyber Resilience For Dummies
body:
Cyber Resilience For DummiesCyber resilience is more than backup and recovery. Customers need a plan to protect critical data, respond to disruption and keep improving their resilience over time.

The Cyber Resilience for Dummies eBook gives you a practical framework to guide that conversation, including risk identification, recovery planning, data protection and continuous improvement. Use it to make a complex topic easier to discuss with customers.

Then take the next step with the Cyber Risk Mitigation & Recovery campaign, already built with the marketing materials you need to reach customers quickly.

Activate Campaign Now

Get the guide, activate the campaign and bring a stronger cyber resilience story to your customers.
